interpretation: Fixed20, within-person signed emotion-minus-control coefficient sensitivity to two event-duration models; not causal RT correction, emotion specificity or a paper-result reproduction.

models.modelA: Pooled participant median of all valid emotion/control RTs for every included trial
models.modelB: Individual valid RT, with the same pooled median only for declared missing RT

events.source_duration: Retained separately; report valid duration-minus-RT and omitted-duration-minus-imputation diagnostics
events.source_duration_difference_count: Count exact nonzero binary64 source_duration_s-response_time_s for included valid-RT rows; descriptive metadata diagnostic, not a scientific threshold.
events.source_row_preconditions: Every original onset finite and >=-24s; every source duration finite and >=0. Preserve all rows. Included target RT must be finite positive or an exact declared missing token. No valid target RT => failed_precondition. Other nonmissing invalid tokens fail rather than coerce.
events.outside_frame_span: Retain diagnostic source onset/end span; no outcome-driven trimming or silent discard. Pinned source events lie within0..270s.

spatial.atlas: Released TemplateFlow Schaefer100/7 in MNI152NLin2009cAsym, res-02
spatial.sphere_rule: Squared world distance <=36, no additional epsilon/rescue/mask

atlas_resampling.domain: After snapping, closed atlas voxel-center domain [0,shape-1]; outside becomes background0
atlas_resampling.warning: Documented deterministic nearest-label convention, not exact legacy SciPy equivalence

spatial.reduction: For each frame and ROI, materialize selected ascending C-order flat voxel indices as a contiguous1D float64 vector; NumPy float64 mean. No stride-dependent2D axis reduction is prescribed.
spatial.grid_id: grid_ + SHA256(b'EMOMATCH_grid_v1\n' + spatial_shape3 as little-endian int64 + chosen effective4x4 affine C-order little-endian float64 with every signed zero normalized to +0 + b'mm\n')
spatial.empty_support: Any required ROI with no geometric voxels => failed_precondition; never invent values or drop a region. All111 supports are nonempty in every authenticated fixed participant.

signal.calibration: Explicit source NIfTI scaling; no silent NaN-to-zero
signal.time_reductions: For nonconstant ROI, mean=math.fsum(float(raw[t,r]) over original frame order)/T; d=float(raw[t,r]-mean); SD=sqrt(math.fsum(d*d over original frame order)/T). This accurate canonical reduction is explicit because arbitrary axis-wise sums can be amplified near constants by the fixed1e-8 floor.
signal.exact_constants: mean=first exact value, SD=0, normalized response=0
signal.raw_scaling: Interpret NIfTI slope nonfinite or0 as effective slope1/intercept0; otherwise require finite intercept and apply float64 stored*slope+intercept. Record raw nullable sentinel values and flags separately.

nuisance.imputation: Finite within-column math.fsum mean in source-frame order; all-missing=>0; retain exact missing mask

design.frame_times: 2*i seconds for every original frame i=0..134. Header and raw/preprocessed sidecars agree on TR2. Origin0 is a computational convention, not a verified exporter slice-time reference; do not discard additional frames.
design.hrf: SPM from pinned Nilearn0.12.1 compute_regressor; unit-height boxes; discrete-sum normalized32s kernel
design.columns: control,emotion,drift_1..K in create_cosine_drift returned order excluding its last constant,13 named nuisances,one literal-ones constant; K=returned.shape[1]-1; absent condition has zero task column

fit.solution: Canonical minimum-norm SVD OLS, not every coefficient statistically identifiable
fit.nonestimable: Retain beta/rank/diagnostics, undefined contrast with false mask and finite zero placeholder
fit.status_precedence: missing_condition if either included condition absent; otherwise contrast_nonestimable if row-space check fails; otherwise ok. Mathematical contrast_estimable remains separately recorded.

groups.uncertainty: Sample SD ddof1, two-sided Student-t/95% CI with19df; descriptive uncorrected endpoint families
groups.incomplete: Any expected person undefined=>null complete-cohort statistics; preserve defined/expected counts
groups.exact_zero_variance: mean and pointCI defined; t/p null, zero_variance status

verification.basis: Canonical authenticated source inputs, never perturbed submitted receipts
verification.group_authority: Accepted activation.csv values for three aggregates and paired changes; accepted primitive NPZ contrasts for individual spheres and equal-parcel network person values; accepted source-bound RT per-person records for RT groups. No second canonical or historical group t/p gate.
verification.contrast_coherence_bound: For independently rounded beta and contrast, permit contrast-envelope(d_ref) + sum_j abs(c_j)*beta-envelope(beta_ref_j) + 8*eps64*P*sum_j abs(c_j*beta_sub_j); also bind each reported beta and contrast separately to canonical source targets.
verification.aggregate_coherence_bound: For independently rounded primitive and aggregate values, permit aggregate-envelope(aggregate_ref) + sum_r abs(weight_r)*contrast-envelope(primitive_ref_r) + 8*eps64*R*sum_r abs(weight_r*primitive_sub_r); bind aggregate separately to canonical target and use accepted aggregate values as group authority.
verification.findings: Nonempty free interpretation; no keyword/direction/model-signature gate
verification.rt_coherence: Per-person condition means and emotion-minus-control differences each bind canonical source at event_timing tolerances. Difference-versus-accepted-means coherence permits difference-envelope + sum abs(weights)*mean-envelope +8*eps64*2*sum abs(weight*submitted_mean), with weights[1,-1]. Accepted per-person difference is the sole RT-difference group authority.

tolerances_proposed_before_original_sign.discrete: IDs, membership, ranks, statuses, masks and source identities exact
tolerances_proposed_before_original_sign.warning: Serialization/computational acceptance policy, not a universal guarantee for arbitrarily ill-conditioned alternate solvers; canonical source and public rank convention are required.

provenance_documentary_duplicates: Original participants.json has two identical NEO_A objects. Authenticate untouched bytes and preserve documentary duplicates losslessly; never consume this field as an analysis input. Timing/manifest JSON remains strict duplicate-key reject.

source_preconditions.inventory: exact131 pinned source files; no replacement participants
source_preconditions.bold_dtype: float32, source header byte order and calibration explicit
source_preconditions.documentary_metadata: Preserve original bytes including duplicated identical participants.json NEO_A; not an analysis field
